import sys,json,csv,io,base64

M=10**12

s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
w.writerow(['icmp','i','0',str(M),'put','h',str(M),'0/i1','2001:db8::1','2001:db8::1','echo','','',''])
cap={'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':M,'end':M+1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],
 'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[M-1,M],'captures':[cap],
 'requests':[{'id':'r','at':M,'lease':'h','target':'2001:db8::1','service':'t','group':'q'}],
 'offers':[{'id':'o','time':M,'service':'t','prefix':'2001:db8::1/128','capacity':1,'cost':1,'group':'oq','requests':['r']}],
 'request_quotas':[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':1}],'offer_quotas':[{'id':'oq','parent':None,'capacity':1}]}
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
print(out['snapshots'])
print(out['active_requests'],out['plan'])
EOF
